review_cost.rationale: I'd ask for one focused fix to the debounce race plus a few nits; everything else is mergeable as-is.

findings.issue: `update()` closes over `filters` from the render that scheduled the debounce, so changing the type or generation select within the 150 ms debounce window navigates using stale query params and silently drops the filter the user just picked.
findings.suggestion: Read current params inside `update` (e.g. `setSearchParams` from `useSearchParams`, or keep filters in a ref updated each render) instead of capturing them per-render.

findings.issue: Module-level cache map never evicts expired entries; stale entries linger until the same URL is requested again. Bounded by the API's own surface, so it won't grow unboundedly, but it's easy to tighten.
findings.suggestion: Delete expired entries on read (or periodically) in `getJson`.

findings.issue: The splat route's loader just throws a 404 and its component renders null; framework mode already renders the root ErrorBoundary with a 404 for unmatched URLs, so the route duplicates built-in behavior.
findings.suggestion: Drop the route (and rely on the root boundary), or render the not-found UI in this route's own component instead of relying on the root boundary.

findings.issue: Cold request for a Pokémon page fans out to every version-group record plus every move record in the selected game — 100+ parallel fetches before the first paint, only mitigated by the 60 s cache.
findings.suggestion: Consider narrowing the fan-out (e.g. only fetch version-group metadata when the select is used, or raise the shared cache TTL for these slow-changing endpoints) and measure.

findings.issue: The 404/error title logic exists in two places: root `meta`'s `errorHeading` and each route's `loaderData ? pageTitle(...) : "Not found – Pokédex"` fallback.
findings.suggestion: Pick one source of truth — e.g. only handle `error` in root meta and let routes define the happy-path title only.

findings.issue: The label fallback `typeNames[name] ?? humanize(name)` is re-implemented in pokemon.tsx:39 and type.tsx:21.
findings.suggestion: Export a `typeLabel(typeNames, name)` helper from lib/api.server.ts (or return precomputed labels from getTypeNames).

findings.issue: An out-of-range `?page=999` is clamped for rendering but the URL keeps the invalid value, so links and reloads disagree with the displayed page.
findings.suggestion: Redirect (or navigate) to the clamped page when `requested` differs from the effective page.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic React Router v8 framework-mode app: typed route modules, URL-as-state filtering in loaders, data()-thrown 404s and correct .server module boundaries, with comments that explain intent. The one change I'd require before merge is the stale-closure race in the home page's debounced search; everything else is a nit. I'd merge after that one round of small fixes.
